issue.title: Bob Refs ⌃D — close a Highlights tab from Tabs
issue.description: In Bob Mac Capture's Bob Refs panel, ⌃D on a Tabs row closes that Highlights tab without leaving the panel. The row folds away, the selection moves to the row that took its place, and a glass toast confirms the close, so ⌃D ⌃D ⌃D clears several tabs in a row. Closing the last open document also quits Highlights. Every close is verified against a fresh Accessibility read, and a failed close puts the row back with a banner.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tab_close.md requests this work

issue.title: RefsCore close contracts, session close, and copy
issue.description: close-core: pure Foundation additions to RefsCore. They add the close result and outcome types, two new reader requirements with safe protocol-extension defaults (so every existing conformer keeps compiling), and `HighlightsTabsSession.close`, which decides the last-tab quit. They also add the closed-tab stack (reopen decision), the after-removal selection rule, and all close copy (toasts, announcement, failure banner). Golden tests run on Linux with `just portable-check`.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tab_close.md defines phase close-core as one work unit

issue.title: Accessibility close ladder and graceful quit
issue.description: close-reader: `AXHighlightsTabsReader` implements `close` and `quitIfNoDocuments`. A close first tries the tab's own close button, then the window's close button when the tab is visible, and only then selects the tab, closes it, and restores the previously visible tab. Every close is verified by bounded re-reads, and an unsaved-changes sheet is detected and handed to Bryan. When no documents remain, Highlights quits through `NSRunningApplication.terminate()`. The phase also runs a read-only Mac probe and adds a CI test.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tab_close.md defines phase close-reader as one work unit

issue.title: Panel close commands, queue, outcomes, keys, and toasts
issue.description: close-model: RefsPanelModel gains ⌃D close commands. A close removes the row optimistically and moves the selection to its neighbour; closes run one at a time in press order; each outcome maps to a toast, banner, state card, or hide. The router sends ⌃D to close only while a tab row is selected (scroll otherwise) and maps ⇧⌘T to reopen. The controller shows the glass toasts. ⌘K gains Close Tab. Model, router, and actions-menu tests run against a fake reader.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202610/highlights_tab_close.md defines phase close-model as one work unit

issue.title: Row close button, footer, inspector hint, motion, design tests, and README
issue.description: close-views: Tabs rows show a quiet close button on hover and selection in a reserved trailing column, and the row exposes a VoiceOver "Close Tab" action. Removals fold out with a short animation (fade only under Reduce Motion). The footer reads "↵ Switch  ⌃D Close Tab", and the inspector card hint and the closed-tab toast style are added, with design fixtures for each. The README covers ⌃D, the last-tab quit, reopen, Privacy, and Troubleshooting.
